items.name: Jerry Seinfeld
items.venue: Smart Financial Centre at Sugar Land
items.caption:
The Seinfeld co-creator and Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee host returns to stand-up.
Jerry Seinfeld performs at Smart Financial Centre at Sugar Land on January 16, 2027. His latest film, Unfrosted, arrived on Netflix in 2024. Tickets on sale now. Link in bio.
